treaty_name: Convention between the Republic of Turkey and the Kingdom of Belgium for the Avoidance of Double Taxation with respect to Taxes on Income, with Protocol (1987)
source_title: Türkiye-Belçika Gelir Üzerinden Alınan Vergilerde Çifte Vergilendirmeyi Önleme Anlaşması ve Protokolü (GİB Turkish text)

rates.quote: a) Temettü elde eden, temettü Ödeyen şirketin sermayesinin doğrudan doğruya en az yüzde 10'unu elinde tutan bir şirket ise (ortaklıklar hariç) gayri safi temettü tutarının yüzde 15'i;
b) Tüm diğer durumlarda gayrisafi temettü tutarının yüzde 20'si.

2. Bununla beraber, bu faiz elde edildiği Akit Devlette ve o Devletin mevzuatına göre de vergilendirilebilir; ancak faizin gerçek lehdarı diğer Akit Devletin bir mukimi ise bu şekilde alınacak vergi, faizin gayrisafi tutarının yüzde 15'ini aşmayacaktır.
ancak gayrimaddi hak bedelinin gerçek lehdarı diğer Akit Devletin bir mukimi ise bu şekilde alınacak vergi, gayrimaddi hak bedelinin gayri safi tutarının yüzde 10'unu aşmayacaktır.

ppt.basis: none (Türkiye signed but is not an MLI Party; no principal-purpose clause)

notes: Art. 29: EIF on the 15th day after the last notification; applies in Türkiye to taxation periods beginning on/after 1 January of the year after EIF and in Belgium to WHT on amounts paid or credited on/after 1 January of the year after EIF -> 1992-01-01 (GİB list 'uygulanmaya başlandığı tarih 01.01.1992'). NOT MODELLED - Protocol para. 4 (ad Art. 10(2)) conditional reductions tied to domestic participation-exemption rules: (a) as long as under Turkish law the relevant company is not subject to income tax on the dividends, the Art. 10(2)(a)/(b) rates are reduced to 5% for dividends received by a Turkish-resident company from a Belgian-resident company; (b) as long as under Belgian law a Belgian-resident company is not subject to corporate tax on dividends received from a Turkish-resident company, the rates are reduced to (i) 10% for dividends paid by a Turkish company to a Belgian company and (ii) 5% for dividends paid by a Belgian company to a Turkish company. Whether these conditions are currently met depends on domestic law and was not verified; the OCR text of para. 4(a) is partly garbled. Interest exempt when paid to the other Government or Central Bank (Art. 11(3)); deferred-payment sales of equipment not treated as interest (Protocol para. 6); technical/consulting service fees not know-how (Protocol para. 7). Protocol para. 5: 'beneficial owner' interpreted to deny benefits to third-country residents. An amending instrument signed 2013-07-09 is listed in Belgium's MLI position without EIF and is absent from the GİB in-force list (23.04.2025) - treated as not in force.
